source_content.pdf_ref: Giải Thích Ngữ Pháp Tiếng Anh — Chương 8: Future Tenses

starter.label: Starter
starter.description_vi: Nhận diện đúng/sai rõ ràng. Câu ngắn, 1 lớp ngữ pháp, distractor rõ.

build_up.label: Build Up
build_up.description_vi: Áp dụng trong ngữ cảnh dài hơn. Lỗi tinh tế hơn, options gần nhau hơn.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.description_vi: 2–3 lớp ngữ pháp đồng thời. Distractor gần đúng, sai ở chi tiết nhỏ.
challenge.distractor_strategy: near_correct — sai ở chi tiết nhỏ

starter.stem: Experts predict that AI ___ many jobs in the next decade.
starter.explanation_short: Dự đoán chung về tương lai → will.
starter.explanation_long: Dự đoán không có bằng chứng cụ thể trước mắt → will. 'Is going to' dùng khi có bằng chứng.
starter.feedback_wrong: Dự đoán tương lai chung → will + V.
starter.ielts_tip: predict + will: dự đoán chung không có bằng chứng cụ thể.

starter.stem: The company ___ a new office in Da Nang next month. Everything is ready.
starter.explanation_short: Kế hoạch đã sắp xếp + bằng chứng → is going to.
starter.explanation_long: 'Everything is ready' = bằng chứng/kế hoạch đã có → is going to open.
starter.feedback_correct: 🔥 Kế hoạch + bằng chứng → is going to open
starter.feedback_wrong: Có kế hoạch/bằng chứng → is going to. Không phải will.
starter.ielts_tip: Kế hoạch có bằng chứng → going to. Dự đoán chung → will.

starter.stem: A: 'The printer is broken.' B: 'Don't worry, I ___ it.'
starter.explanation_short: Quyết định tức thì tại thời điểm nói → will.
starter.explanation_long: 'Will' dùng cho quyết định ngay lúc nói. 'Going to' dùng cho kế hoạch đã có từ trước.
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ Quyết định tức thì → will fix
starter.feedback_wrong: Quyết định ngay lúc nói → will. Kế hoạch từ trước → going to.
starter.ielts_tip: will = spontaneous decision. going to = planned decision.

starter.stem: She ___ attend the tech conference tomorrow.
starter.explanation_short: will + V nguyên mẫu (không có to).
starter.explanation_long: will + bare infinitive: will attend. Không dùng 'will to attend'.
starter.ielts_tip: will + V bare infinitive. Không bao giờ 'will to V'.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: will to (sai), is will (sai), going will (sai)

starter.stem: The new software ___ be available until next Friday.
starter.explanation_short: until next Friday = chưa có → phủ định: won't be available.
starter.explanation_long: 'Until next Friday' ngụ ý chưa có cho đến thứ Sáu → won't (will not).
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ Chưa available → won't be available until...
starter.feedback_wrong: until = chưa có → won't + V: won't be available.
starter.ielts_tip: won't + V until + time = sẽ không... cho đến khi...
starter.distractor_note: obvious: will (khẳng định, sai nghĩa), doesn't (Simple Present)

starter.stem: Look at those dark clouds! It ___ rain soon.
starter.explanation_short: Có bằng chứng (dark clouds) → is going to.
starter.explanation_long: 'Dark clouds' = bằng chứng trước mắt → is going to rain. Không phải will (dự đoán chung).
starter.feedback_correct: 🔥 Bằng chứng trước mắt → is going to rain
starter.feedback_wrong: Bằng chứng (dark clouds) → is going to. Will = dự đoán chung.
starter.ielts_tip: Có evidence → going to. Dự đoán opinion → will.

starter.stem: I ___ you the report by 5pm, I promise.
starter.explanation_long: 'I promise' + will = lời hứa. Going to dùng cho kế hoạch, không phải lời hứa.
starter.feedback_wrong: Lời hứa → will. Kế hoạch → going to.

starter.stem: We ___ a new CRM system next quarter. The budget has been approved.
starter.explanation_short: Budget approved = kế hoạch đã có → are going to.
starter.explanation_long: 'Budget has been approved' = kế hoạch đã sẵn sàng → are going to implement.
starter.feedback_correct: 🔥 Kế hoạch đã có → are going to implement
starter.feedback_wrong: Budget approved = kế hoạch → going to. Không phải will.
starter.ielts_tip: Kế hoạch + bằng chứng → going to. Spontaneous → will.

starter.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The manager will to review all applications tomorrow.'
starter.explanation_short: will + V nguyên mẫu: will review (không will to review).
starter.explanation_long: will + bare infinitive. 'Will to review' = sai. Phải bỏ 'to': will review.
starter.feedback_wrong: will + V bare infinitive. Không bao giờ 'will to V'.
starter.ielts_tip: will + V (no to). Lỗi phổ biến do ảnh hưởng tiếng Việt.

starter.stem: Technology ___ continue to shape the future of work.
starter.explanation_short: Dự đoán chung về xu hướng tương lai → will.
starter.explanation_long: Dự đoán mang tính opinion/general prediction → will.
starter.ielts_tip: Task 2: Technology will continue/improve/change... → will cho dự đoán.

build_up.stem: The government ___ new regulations next year, as the draft has already been finalized.
build_up.explanation_short: Draft finalized = kế hoạch → going to.
build_up.explanation_long: 'Draft has been finalized' = bằng chứng kế hoạch → is going to introduce.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 Kế hoạch đã finalize → going to introduce
build_up.feedback_wrong: Draft finalized = kế hoạch → going to.
build_up.ielts_tip: Kế hoạch có evidence → going to. Opinion → will.

build_up.stem: Many analysts believe that remote work ___ the dominant model by 2030.
build_up.explanation_short: believe (opinion) + dự đoán tương lai → will.
build_up.explanation_long: 'Analysts believe' = opinion → dự đoán dùng will. Không có bằng chứng trực tiếp.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: is going to become (cũng đúng nhưng will chuẩn hơn với believe)

build_up.stem: The tech startup has secured $10 million in funding. They ___ 200 new employees.
build_up.explanation_short: Đã secured funding = bằng chứng/kế hoạch → going to.
build_up.explanation_long: 'Has secured $10M' = bằng chứng cụ thể → are going to hire.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 Bằng chứng cụ thể → going to hire
build_up.feedback_wrong: Funding secured = kế hoạch → going to.
build_up.ielts_tip: Bằng chứng + kế hoạch → going to.

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The company will opens a new branch in Ho Chi Minh City.'
options: Sai: will opens → will open (will + V bare infinitive)
build_up.correct_answer: Sai: will opens → will open (will + V bare infinitive)
build_up.explanation_short: will + V nguyên mẫu: will open (không thêm -s).
build_up.explanation_long: Sau will dùng V nguyên mẫu, không chia: will open (không will opens).
build_up.feedback_correct: 🎯 will + V bare infinitive: will open
build_up.ielts_tip: will + V bare infinitive. Không bao giờ thêm -s/-ed/-ing sau will.

build_up.stem: In conclusion, automation ___ reshape the job market, and workers will need to adapt.
build_up.explanation_short: Câu kết bài Task 2, dự đoán chung → will.
build_up.explanation_long: Trong câu kết luận Task 2, dùng will cho dự đoán mang tính khẳng định.
build_up.feedback_correct: ⚡ Kết bài Task 2 + dự đoán → will
build_up.feedback_wrong: Câu kết bài Task 2 → will cho dự đoán khẳng định.
build_up.ielts_tip: Task 2 conclusion: will + V = dự đoán mạnh.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: is going to (cũng đúng nhưng kém formal trong kết bài)

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The team going to present the project results tomorrow.'
options: Sai: going to → is going to (thiếu be)
build_up.correct_answer: Sai: going to → is going to (thiếu be)
build_up.explanation_short: be going to: The team IS going to present.
build_up.explanation_long: Cấu trúc: S + be + going to + V. Thiếu 'is' → sai.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 Thiếu be: is going to present
build_up.feedback_wrong: be going to: S + am/is/are + going to + V.
build_up.ielts_tip: S + be + going to + V. Thiếu be = lỗi phổ biến.

build_up.explanation_long: Offer spontaneous → will. 'I will get you a coffee' = đề nghị ngay lúc nói.
build_up.feedback_correct: ⚡ Đề nghị tức thì → will get
build_up.feedback_wrong: Offer tức thì → will. Kế hoạch → going to.
build_up.ielts_tip: will = spontaneous offer. going to = planned action.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: am going to get (kế hoạch, không phải offer)

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The new policy willn't affect current employees.'
build_up.explanation_long: Viết tắt đúng: will not → won't. 'Willn't' không tồn tại.
build_up.feedback_wrong: will not = won't. Không có dạng willn't.

build_up.stem: I think technology ___ solve most of our current problems.
build_up.explanation_short: I think + dự đoán cá nhân → will.
build_up.explanation_long: 'I think' = opinion → will. Going to dùng khi có evidence, không phải opinion.
build_up.feedback_wrong: I think + will = dự đoán cá nhân.
build_up.ielts_tip: Speaking Part 3: I think/believe + will + V.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: is going to (cũng gần đúng)

build_up.stem: According to the project timeline, the team ___ the app by December.
build_up.explanation_short: Project timeline = kế hoạch cụ thể → going to.
build_up.explanation_long: 'According to the project timeline' = kế hoạch đã lập → is going to launch.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 Kế hoạch cụ thể → going to launch

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The research shows clear trends: AI is going to dominate industry, and I think unemployment will to rise.'
options: AI is going to dominate industry
challenge.explanation_short: will + V bare infinitive: will rise (không will to rise).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'will to rise' → 'will rise' (không dùng to sau will). Lớp 2: 'is going to dominate' = đúng vì có evidence (research shows).
challenge.feedback_correct: 🔥 will + V bare infinitive: will rise!
challenge.ielts_tip: will + V (no to). going to + V (có evidence).
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B trông có vẻ sai nhưng going to + evidence = đúng

challenge.stem: Câu kết bài Task 2 nào CHUẨN NHẤT?
options: technology is going to continue transforming the workplace.
technology will continue to transform the workplace.
technology will to continue transforming the workplace.
technology continues to transform the workplace.
challenge.correct_answer: In conclusion, technology will continue to transform the workplace.
challenge.explanation_short: Câu kết bài + dự đoán → will (formal hơn going to).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: will + continue = formal, chuẩn academic. Lớp 2: 'is going to' cũng đúng nhưng kém formal. Lớp 3: 'will to continue' = sai (will + V bare).
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 will continue = chuẩn câu kết bài!
challenge.feedback_wrong: will + V = formal prediction trong conclusion.
challenge.ielts_tip: Conclusion Task 2: will + V = formal prediction.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A đúng ngữ pháp nhưng kém formal
layers: will vs going to in academic

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The company going to invest heavily in renewable energy, which will create many green jobs.'
challenge.explanation_short: Thiếu is: The company IS going to invest.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: be going to → 'The company is going to invest'. Thiếu 'is'. Lớp 2: 'which will create' = đúng.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🔥 Thiếu be: is going to invest!
challenge.feedback_wrong: S + be + going to + V. Thiếu be = sai.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C trông có vẻ sai nhưng will create = đúng

challenge.stem: Chọn câu ĐÚNG NHẤT phân biệt will và going to:
options: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow so I'm going to bring an umbrella.
The weather forecast says it is going to rain tomorrow so I will bring an umbrella.
The weather forecast says it is going to rain tomorrow so I'm going to bring an umbrella.
The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow so I will bring an umbrella.
challenge.correct_answer: The weather forecast says it is going to rain tomorrow so I'm going to bring an umbrella.
challenge.explanation_short: Forecast = evidence → going to rain. Kế hoạch → going to bring.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: forecast = bằng chứng → going to rain. Lớp 2: bring umbrella = kế hoạch dựa trên evidence → going to bring. Cả hai đều going to vì đều có evidence/plan.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 Evidence → going to rain. Plan → going to bring!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Forecast = evidence → going to. Plan based on evidence → going to.
challenge.ielts_tip: Evidence → going to. Plan → going to. Spontaneous → will.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B (going to rain + will bring) cũng gần đúng — will bring = spontaneous decision

challenge.stem:
Câu nào ĐÚNG HOÀN TOÀN cho IELTS Writing?
'Some people argue that robots ___ [A] many workers, while others believe that technology ___ [B] new opportunities.'
options: [A] will replace / [B] is going to create
[A] are going to replace / [B] are going to create
challenge.explanation_short: argue/believe = opinions → will cho cả hai.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'argue' = opinion → will replace. Lớp 2: 'believe' = opinion → will create. Cả hai vế đều là dự đoán dựa trên ý kiến → will.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 argue/believe = opinions → will cho cả hai!
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A trộn will/going to — không nhất quán

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Current data shows that sea levels will rise dramatically, and coastal cities is going to face serious flooding.'
options: and coastal cities is going to
challenge.correct_answer: and coastal cities is going to
challenge.explanation_short: cities = plural → ARE going to (không is).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'cities' = số nhiều → 'are going to' (không 'is going to'). Lớp 2: 'sea levels will rise' cũng nên là 'are going to rise' vì có data (evidence), nhưng option C sai rõ ràng hơn.
challenge.feedback_wrong: cities = plural → are going to, không phải is.
challenge.ielts_tip: S + am/is/are + going to. Số nhiều → are.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B (will rise → going to rise vì có data) cũng có thể sai nhẹ

challenge.stem: Chọn câu body paragraph Task 2 CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: the economy is going to benefit significantly.
If governments will invest in education
If governments are going to invest in education
challenge.correct_answer: If governments invest in education, the economy will benefit significantly.
challenge.explanation_short: If + Present Simple, will + V = First Conditional chuẩn.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: If + Present Simple (invest) → will + V (benefit). Lớp 2: 'If + will' = sai (không dùng will trong if-clause). Lớp 3: Option A đúng ngữ pháp nhưng kém formal.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 If + Present Simple, will + V = chuẩn!
challenge.feedback_wrong: If + V (Present), will + V. Không dùng will trong if-clause.
challenge.ielts_tip: If + Present, will + V. Conditional Type 1.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C (If + will) = lỗi phổ biến

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The report predicts that unemployment will increases and the government will needs to take action.'
challenge.explanation_short: will + V bare: will increase (không will increases).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'will increases' → 'will increase' (không thêm -s sau will). Lớp 2: 'will needs' cũng sai → 'will need'. Cả B và C đều sai, B sai trước.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🔥 will + V bare: increase, không increases!
challenge.feedback_wrong: will + V bare infinitive. Không thêm -s/-ed sau will.
challenge.ielts_tip: will + V (no -s). Lỗi phổ biến do quen chia ngôi 3.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C (will needs) cũng sai — bẫy kép

challenge.stem: Chọn cặp câu ĐÚNG NHẤT phân biệt will vs going to:
options: Research shows that global temperatures will rise. Therefore
Research shows that global temperatures are going to rise. Therefore
we are going to implement new policies.
Research shows that global temperatures are going to rise. Therefore
Research shows that global temperatures will rise. Therefore
we are going to implement new policies.
challenge.correct_answer: Research shows that global temperatures are going to rise. Therefore, we are going to implement new policies.
challenge.explanation_short: Research shows = evidence → going to rise. Implement policies = plan → going to.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'Research shows' = evidence → going to rise. Lớp 2: 'implement new policies' = kế hoạch dựa trên evidence → going to implement.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 Evidence → going to. Plan → going to!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Evidence → going to. Plan based on evidence → going to.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C (going to + will) cũng có thể đúng — will cho spontaneous decision

challenge.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn Task 2 có BAO NHIÊU phrase chứa lỗi?
'According to experts, automation [A] will to eliminate many jobs, companies [B] is going to need to retrain workers, and the government [C] will provides financial support.'
challenge.explanation_short: [A] will to → will. [B] is → are (companies = plural). [C] will provides → will provide.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: [A] 'will to eliminate' → 'will eliminate' (will + V bare). Lớp 2: [B] 'companies is going to' → 'companies are going to' (plural). Lớp 3: [C] 'will provides' → 'will provide' (will + V bare, no -s).
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 BOSS CLEARED! [A] will eliminate | [B] are going to | [C] will provide!
challenge.feedback_wrong: [A] will + V (no to). [B] companies = plural → are. [C] will + V (no -s).
challenge.ielts_tip: will + V bare (no to, no -s). S (plural) + are going to.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B bỏ sót [B]. Option A bỏ sót [B] và [C].

items.feedback_wrong: Funding secured = kế hoạch → going to.
items.explanation_short: Đã secured funding = bằng chứng/kế hoạch → going to.
items.ielts_tip: Bằng chứng + kế hoạch → going to.

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The company will opens a new branch in Ho Chi Minh City.'
options: Sai: will opens → will open (will + V bare infinitive)
items.correct_answer: Sai: will opens → will open (will + V bare infinitive)
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 will + V bare infinitive: will open
items.feedback_wrong: will + V (không chia): will open.
items.explanation_short: will + V nguyên mẫu: will open (không thêm -s).
items.ielts_tip: will + V bare infinitive. Không bao giờ thêm -s/-ed/-ing sau will.

items.stem: In conclusion, automation ___ reshape the job market, and workers will need to adapt.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ Kết bài Task 2 + dự đoán → will
items.feedback_wrong: Câu kết bài Task 2 → will cho dự đoán khẳng định.
items.explanation_short: Câu kết bài Task 2, dự đoán chung → will.
items.ielts_tip: Task 2 conclusion: will + V = dự đoán mạnh.

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The team going to present the project results tomorrow.'
options: Sai: going to → is going to (thiếu be)
items.correct_answer: Sai: going to → is going to (thiếu be)
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 Thiếu be: is going to present
items.feedback_wrong: be going to: S + am/is/are + going to + V.
items.explanation_short: be going to: The team IS going to present.
items.ielts_tip: S + be + going to + V. Thiếu be = lỗi phổ biến.

items.stem: 'You look tired.' — 'I ___ you a coffee.'
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ Đề nghị tức thì → will get
items.feedback_wrong: Offer tức thì → will. Kế hoạch → going to.
items.explanation_short: Đề nghị tức thì → will.
items.ielts_tip: will = spontaneous offer. going to = planned action.

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The new policy willn't affect current employees.'
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 will not → won't (không phải willn't)
items.feedback_wrong: will not = won't. Không có dạng willn't.
items.explanation_short: will not = won't (không phải willn't).
items.ielts_tip: won't = will not. Contraction chuẩn.

items.stem: I think technology ___ solve most of our current problems.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ I think + prediction → will solve
items.feedback_wrong: I think + will = dự đoán cá nhân.
items.explanation_short: I think + dự đoán cá nhân → will.
items.ielts_tip: Speaking Part 3: I think/believe + will + V.

items.stem: According to the project timeline, the team ___ the app by December.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 Kế hoạch cụ thể → going to launch
items.feedback_wrong: Timeline = kế hoạch → going to.
items.explanation_short: Project timeline = kế hoạch cụ thể → going to.
items.ielts_tip: According to plan/schedule → going to.

weak_topic_detection.logic: sai ≥2 câu cùng error_tag → weak topic

ui.title: ⚡ Speed Drill — Challenge
ui.description: 2–3 lớp ngữ pháp đồng thời. Distractor gần đúng, sai ở chi tiết nhỏ.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The research shows clear trends: AI is going to dominate industry, and I think unemployment will to rise.'
options: AI is going to dominate industry
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 will + V bare infinitive: will rise!
items.feedback_wrong: will + V (không to): will rise.
items.explanation_short: will + V bare infinitive: will rise (không will to rise).
items.ielts_tip: will + V (no to). going to + V (có evidence).

items.stem: Câu kết bài Task 2 nào CHUẨN NHẤT?
options: technology is going to continue transforming the workplace.
technology will continue to transform the workplace.
technology will to continue transforming the workplace.
technology continues to transform the workplace.
items.correct_answer: In conclusion, technology will continue to transform the workplace.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 will continue = chuẩn câu kết bài!
items.feedback_wrong: will + V = formal prediction trong conclusion.
items.explanation_short: Câu kết bài + dự đoán → will (formal hơn going to).
items.ielts_tip: Conclusion Task 2: will + V = formal prediction.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The company going to invest heavily in renewable energy, which will create many green jobs.'
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 Thiếu be: is going to invest!
items.feedback_wrong: S + be + going to + V. Thiếu be = sai.
items.explanation_short: Thiếu is: The company IS going to invest.
items.ielts_tip: S + am/is/are + going to + V.

items.stem: Chọn câu ĐÚNG NHẤT phân biệt will và going to:
options: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow so I'm going to bring an umbrella.
The weather forecast says it is going to rain tomorrow so I will bring an umbrella.
The weather forecast says it is going to rain tomorrow so I'm going to bring an umbrella.
The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow so I will bring an umbrella.
items.correct_answer: The weather forecast says it is going to rain tomorrow so I'm going to bring an umbrella.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 Evidence → going to rain. Plan → going to bring!
items.feedback_wrong: Forecast = evidence → going to. Plan based on evidence → going to.
items.explanation_short: Forecast = evidence → going to rain. Kế hoạch → going to bring.
items.ielts_tip: Evidence → going to. Plan → going to. Spontaneous → will.

items.stem:
Câu nào ĐÚNG HOÀN TOÀN cho IELTS Writing?
'Some people argue that robots ___ [A] many workers, while others believe that technology ___ [B] new opportunities.'
options: [A] will replace / [B] is going to create
[A] are going to replace / [B] are going to create
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 argue/believe = opinions → will cho cả hai!
items.feedback_wrong: Opinions/predictions → will. Evidence → going to.
items.explanation_short: argue/believe = opinions → will cho cả hai.
items.ielts_tip: Task 2: argue/believe/predict + will + V.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Current data shows that sea levels will rise dramatically, and coastal cities is going to face serious flooding.'
options: and coastal cities is going to
items.correct_answer: and coastal cities is going to
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 cities = plural → are going to!
items.feedback_wrong: cities = plural → are going to, không phải is.
items.explanation_short: cities = plural → ARE going to (không is).
items.ielts_tip: S + am/is/are + going to. Số nhiều → are.

items.stem: Chọn câu body paragraph Task 2 CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: the economy is going to benefit significantly.
If governments will invest in education
If governments are going to invest in education
items.correct_answer: If governments invest in education, the economy will benefit significantly.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 If + Present Simple, will + V = chuẩn!
items.feedback_wrong: If + V (Present), will + V. Không dùng will trong if-clause.
items.explanation_short: If + Present Simple, will + V = First Conditional chuẩn.
items.ielts_tip: If + Present, will + V. Conditional Type 1.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The report predicts that unemployment will increases and the government will needs to take action.'
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 will + V bare: increase, không increases!
items.feedback_wrong: will + V bare infinitive. Không thêm -s/-ed sau will.
items.explanation_short: will + V bare: will increase (không will increases).
items.ielts_tip: will + V (no -s). Lỗi phổ biến do quen chia ngôi 3.

items.stem: Chọn cặp câu ĐÚNG NHẤT phân biệt will vs going to:
options: Research shows that global temperatures will rise. Therefore
Research shows that global temperatures are going to rise. Therefore
we are going to implement new policies.
Research shows that global temperatures are going to rise. Therefore
Research shows that global temperatures will rise. Therefore
we are going to implement new policies.
items.correct_answer: Research shows that global temperatures are going to rise. Therefore, we are going to implement new policies.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 Evidence → going to. Plan → going to!
items.feedback_wrong: Evidence → going to. Plan based on evidence → going to.
items.explanation_short: Research shows = evidence → going to rise. Implement policies = plan → going to.
items.ielts_tip: evidence/data → going to. opinion/think → will.

items.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn Task 2 có BAO NHIÊU phrase chứa lỗi?
'According to experts, automation [A] will to eliminate many jobs, companies [B] is going to need to retrain workers, and the government [C] will provides financial support.'
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 BOSS CLEARED! [A] will eliminate | [B] are going to | [C] will provide!
items.feedback_wrong: [A] will + V (no to). [B] companies = plural → are. [C] will + V (no -s).
items.explanation_short: [A] will to → will. [B] is → are (companies = plural). [C] will provides → will provide.
items.ielts_tip: will + V bare (no to, no -s). S (plural) + are going to.

weak_topic_detection.logic: sai ≥2 câu cùng error_tag → weak topic
